comment: DMR (ETSI TS 102 361) bursts: 4FSK at 4800 symbols a second (h 0.27: +-648, +-1944 Hz).
The discriminator's levels are timed and each burst found by the 24-symbol sync in its middle, any of the eight
patterns (base station, mobile, direct mode slot 1 or 2; voice or data), matched in phase (a voice pattern is its
data pattern inverted, so the sense must be known) and published as `word`;
the burst is the 54 symbols before it, the sync, and the 54 after, scaled by the sync's +-3.
Every burst's slot type (Golay (20,8), its halves on either side of the sync) gives the colour code and data
type; a data burst's 196 information bits (both sides) are deinterleaved and BPTC (196,96) decoded to 12 octets.
Out come the slot types and the data bursts' octets as messages;
the CACH between bursts and voice payloads are not read. The capture is the channel at `sps` samples a symbol,
block estimation over 256-symbol windows (its square-law line is weak at this roll-off:
no gate, the phase alone, tracked)

data.when: word == 'bs_data' or word == 'ms_data' or word == 'ts1_data' or word == 'ts2_data'
